title: Read hosted design versions
responsibility: Validate committed design metadata and expose versions or exact verified image bytes.

inputs.name: hubDesigns.context
inputs.description: Authorized source context with repository, pinned commit, tree entries, source adapter and cache identity.

inputs.name: hubDesigns.plan
inputs.description: Plan identity and path whose versions are read.

inputs.name: hubDesignImage.context
inputs.description: Authorized source context with repository, pinned commit, tree entries, source adapter and cache identity.

outputs.name: hubDesigns
outputs.description: Sequentially numbered versions with prompt/notes, images, option metadata and matching approvals; only the latest version’s approval is marked current, and creation commit is initially null.

outputs.name: hubDesignImage
outputs.description: PNG bytes for the matching hash after content hash, length and dimensions are checked.
